assumptions: World Runtime or an owning script supplies the authoritative restock schedule and target.
Classic container restock record mappings remain unproven and are not auto-projected.
safe_fallback: Reject missing identities, malformed targets, non-container targets, capacity overflow, and excess existing state without mutation.
runtime_impact: Portable item containers can reconcile evidence-projected contents to an explicit target while preserving runtime identities.
character_save_impact: Container contents and instance identities persist through the existing item-state serializer.
world_state_impact: No scheduling state is invented; only explicitly invoked container reconciliation mutates item state.
